$comment: === BTA 8.0.1 mapping ============================================ Every version-specific fact the code generator knows lives in THIS file: fully-qualified class names, halplibe builder-method shapes, registration idioms, ID ranges, gradle coordinates. To support a new BTA version: duplicate this file as bta-<ver>.json, fix the strings that changed, register it in mappings/index.ts. No UI or emitter code should ever need touching. Snippet tokens use {{name}} and are filled by the emitters.

imports.$comment: Symbol -> FQN. Emitters reference symbols only; the JavaWriter resolves + dedupes imports from this table.

idRanges.$comment: BTA still runs on numeric registry IDs. Artemis allocates sequentially from these bases at generate time (deterministic: element creation order). Bases sit high above vanilla + common mods; the generated config exposes them so end users can shift the whole band on conflict.

materials.$comment: UI dropdown value -> Materials field. Verified against net.minecraft.core.block.material.Materials in the BTA 8.0.1 client jar; the old lowercase Material.stone style fields are gone.

blockTags.$comment: UI toggle key -> BlockTags constant, verified against the BTA 8.0.1 client jar. Tool mineability doubles as the effective-tool system in BTA.

blockBuilder.$comment: halplibe BlockBuilder chain, verified against halplibe 6.1.4. build() takes a BlockLogicSupplier, not a Material, and the builder has no texture methods at all: art is resolved from the registry key by TextureHelper, so the PNG just has to be at assets/<modid>/textures/block/<key>.png.
blockBuilder.decl: public static final Block<BlockLogic> {{FIELD}} = new BlockBuilder(MOD_ID)

tree.$comment: Whole-file template for the tree WorldFeature. The world mutation API is the most version-volatile surface in BTA, so the entire generate() body lives here rather than in an emitter.

mob.$comment: Whole-file template for generated mob classes. {{extends}} comes from entity.mobClassExtends; hostile mobs get the melee-attack override block via {{hostileBody}}.

itemBuilder.$comment: halplibe ItemBuilder, verified against 6.1.4. build() takes the finished Item, and there is no setIcon: item art is stitched from assets/<modid>/textures/item/<key>.png by key.
itemBuilder.decl: public static final Item {{FIELD}} = new ItemBuilder(MOD_ID)

toolMaterial.$comment: One ToolMaterial feeds the whole tool run. Verified: ToolMaterial has a no-arg constructor plus setDurability/setEfficiency(float,float)/setMiningLevel/setDamage, and each tool is a plain net.minecraft.core.item.tool.ItemToolX(name, key, id, material). There is no ToolHelper.

armorMaterial.$comment: ArmorHelper.createArmorMaterial(namespace, key, durability, f x6) where the floats are protection percentages per DamageType in declaration order: COMBAT, BLAST, FALL, FIRE, DROWN, GENERIC. Pieces are plain ItemArmor<HumanArmorShape> instances; createArmorItem does not exist.

recipes.$comment: RecipeBuilder idioms. Shaped rows are 3 strings; symbols map char->itemstack expression.

biome.$comment: Registration mirrors how the BOP/Twilight-style BTA ports do it: declare Biome, register through BiomeHelper with climate + surface config, then attach to world-type ranges.
biome.decl:
public static final Biome {{FIELD}} = BiomeHelper.createBiome(MOD_ID, "{{registryName}}", b -> b
{{chain}});

entrypoint.$comment: Main mod class skeleton. {{BODY_*}} slots are filled by CodeGenerator with per-element registration/init calls.

gradle.$comment: Workspace scaffold, matched against Turnip-Labs/bta-example-mod on its 8.0 branch. BTA 8.x builds on UPSTREAM fabric-loom, not the old babric-loom fork, and pulls the game through customMinecraftMetadata rather than a maven coordinate. halplibe's release tag is resolved live at export and the maven version appends mavenSuffix.

obfuscation.$comment: ProGuard-based name obfuscation for the exported mod. The keep-list protects everything the loader/Mixin/reflection reach; package names here are BTA-version-specific so they live in the mapping. shrink/optimize are intentionally OFF in the generated config, renaming is the safe subset; shrinking dead-strips reflectively-used members and optimization rewrites bytecode Mixin can't follow.

oreGen.$comment: Ore worldgen is a Mixin in BTA 8: ChunkDecorator.decorate(Chunk) is the only hook and halplibe offers nothing for it, so the mod injects at the TAIL of ChunkDecoratorOverworld.decorate and places its own veins. remap=false because BTA ships unmapped. The per-chunk Random is seeded from the chunk coordinates so terrain stays reproducible for a given seed.
